frameReuseBasis.earlyVisibility: 2352 ray samples per frame: no printed-envelope point visible through frame52; first2 at frame53. Start50 adds3-frame margin.
frameReuseBasis.lateVisibility: Independent evaluated-triangle projection: conservative printed UV envelope u[.06,.94],v[.05,.93] still intersects frame104; frames105-144 all outside viewport.
frameReuseBasis.backsideCorrection: Solidify back faces require a separate material; evaluated reverse printing first potentially faces camera at83. Final frames80-104 are required from the two-sided scene (3-frame margin); earlier front renders remain valid.
frameReuseBasis.boundary: Leaf geometry remains as a narrow spine strip at the endpoint; only added printing has left view. Unprinted regions retain the original paper shader. Secondary offscreen colour bounce is not a bit-exact equivalence claim.

buildCommands: Existing front-study native frames50-79 are reused; their scene and frame fingerprints remain in render.records.
python3 model-src/cinematic/leaf_border_run.py --theme THEME --frames FIRST,SECOND,THIRD (CPU-only, at most3 frames/process; serially cover frames80-104, retaining completed full CPU light94)
productionBoundary: Final corrected segment uses CPU,4threads,256px tiles,persistent data disabled, serial batches of at most3 frames. All evaluated leaf vertices determine a native render border with32px margin; cropped pixels are pasted without scaling or blending onto preserved baseline frames. Pixels outside that region retain the baseline, omitting minute distant indirect colour bounce from the changed printing. Full native CPU light94 remains an independent reference and final frame. No claim of bit-identical CPU/Metal denoising; original optical and48sample settings remain unchanged. Every3seconds the guard stops our child at available memory<65% or wired>5GiB. The failed one-frame Metal experiment remains recorded; Metal is not the recommended production path. Physical-art acceptance remains with the user.
sourceBoundary: sourceHashes are final delivery scripts. sourceHashesAtSceneBuild records the original material-scene build snapshot; later reverse-script changes concern CPU render configuration, and archive/reverse module docstrings now point to the guarded CPU path. The saved two-sided blend fingerprint is authoritative for all corrected pixels, and per-frame records preserve the exact renderer/assembler script fingerprints used.
